title: 第419章 玄刹姬 死死都给本王死第418章 血魅魔主的诱惑
content_zh:
第一卷第419章玄刹姬：死！死！！都给本王死！！！
楚枫浑身骤然紧绷，面上虽强装镇定，心中却已翻涌起惊涛骇浪。
识时务者为俊杰，他立即收敛了所有戒备的姿态，躬身拱手。
“魔主大人说笑了，晚辈不过侥幸得了天魔令才混入秘境，怎会认识月烬魔主那样的绝世人物。”
“真的？”
血魅魔主的脸上浮现出一抹意味深长的笑意，美眸骤然亮起一道粉红光芒。
那光芒如同两根无形的针，直接刺向楚枫的瞳孔深处。
魅影天幻术！
这是她的独门幻术，以神魂之力凝聚魅影法则，可侵入对方识海窥探记忆，便是仙帝初期的强者在全无防备之下也难以抵挡。
她不知道楚枫和月烬有什么瓜葛，但没关系，只要看了他的记忆，一切都会水落石出。
然而就在那魅影天幻术即将侵入楚枫识海的瞬间，楚枫眉心深处骤然亮起一道金色光芒。
临字秘术！
秘术法则直接让楚枫看破了一切虚妄，他站在原地只是愣了一下，随即便反应了过来，这个女人对他施展了幻术。
血魅魔主愣了一下，她看了看楚枫那双依旧清明如水的眼眸，脸上露出一丝疑惑之色。
她的魅影天幻术竟然对这个金仙无用？
“有趣……”
话音刚落，楚枫身旁空间突然再次震荡。
三道身影几乎同时出现在他身后不远处的阴冥之地上，那空间传送的波动还未完全散去，阴气被搅得四散翻涌。
其中两人是双胞胎兄弟，身量几乎一模一样。
他们是魔界颇有名气的散修，阎青与阎煞，修为皆在仙圣初期。

兄弟二人联手时战力足以抗衡仙圣后期，在散修中也算一方人物。
另一人正是那位头戴帷帽的女子，她环顾四周，在看到血魅魔主之时不由美眸一凝。
就在此时，血魅魔主拍了拍楚枫的肩膀。
一道粉红雾气顺着她的掌心涌入楚枫体内，在他经脉中一闪而逝，快得让他来不及催动仙力抵挡。
与此同时，血魅魔主凑到了楚枫的耳旁，吐气如兰。
“我在秘境里边等你……”
血魅魔主收回手，转身面向那片阴魂密布的阴冥之地。
她周身骤然迸发出令人窒息的仙帝威压，血色光芒从她体内冲天而起，将半边阴冥之地的天穹都染成了触目惊心的红色。
阴气在接触到她周身血光的瞬间便被蒸发殆尽，那些阴魂发出凄厉的惨叫，却连逃都来不及逃，便被血光中蕴含的魅影法则烧成了虚无。
“魅影血遁！”
她红唇轻启，身形骤然化作一道粉红流光，如同一柄贯穿天地的利刃般直接切入了阴冥之地的深处。
流光所过之处虚空剧烈震荡，无数道漆黑的空间裂缝从轨迹两侧朝四面八方疯狂蔓延。
任何拦在流光前方的阴魂，都在接触流光的瞬间被撞得魂飞魄散。
那道粉红流光横贯整个阴冥之地，如同一条横跨天际的粉红银河。
粉红雾气流转形成一道长廊，将周围的阴气尽数隔绝在外。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 419 Xuansha Ji: Die! die! ! All die to this king! ! !
Chu Feng's whole body suddenly tensed up. Although he pretended to be calm on his face, there was already a turmoil in his heart.
A man who knows the current affairs is a hero. He immediately put aside all his guarded postures and bowed his hands.
"Lord Demon Lord, you are joking. I just got the Heavenly Demon Order by luck and got into the secret realm. How could I know such a peerless person like Lord Moon Ash?"
"Really?"
A meaningful smile appeared on the face of the Blood Charm Lord, and his beautiful eyes suddenly lit up with a pink light.
The light was like two invisible needles, piercing directly into the depths of Chu Feng's pupils.
Phantom Sky Illusion!
This is her unique illusion technique, which uses the power of the soul to condense the phantom law. It can invade the opponent's sea of ​​consciousness and peek into the memory. Even the strong ones in the early stage of the Immortal Emperor are unable to resist without any defense.
She didn't know what the relationship between Chu Feng and Yue Jin was, but it didn't matter. As long as she looked at his memory, everything would come to light.
However, at the moment when the phantom sky illusion was about to invade Chu Feng's sea of ​​consciousness, a golden light suddenly lit up deep in the center of Chu Feng's eyebrows.
The secret technique of Linzi!
The secret law directly allowed Chu Feng to see through all the illusions. He stood there stunned for a moment, and then realized that this woman had cast an illusion on him.
The Blood Charm Lord was stunned for a moment. She looked at Chu Feng's eyes that were still as clear as water, with a trace of doubt on her face.
Her phantom sky illusion is useless against this golden immortal?
"Interesting..."
As soon as he finished speaking, the space around Chu Feng suddenly shook again.
Three figures appeared in the Yin Ming Land not far behind him almost at the same time. The fluctuations in the space transmission had not completely dissipated, and the Yin Qi was stirred up and surged in all directions.
Two of them are twin brothers, almost identical in stature.
They are well-known casual cultivators in the demon world. Yan Qing and Yan Sha are both in the early stage of Immortal Sage cultivation.
When the two brothers join forces, their combat power is enough to compete with the late Immortal Saint, and they can also be regarded as one of the heroes among casual cultivators.
The other person was the woman wearing a curtain hat. She looked around, and when she saw the Blood Charm Demon Lord, her beautiful eyes couldn't help but condense.
At this moment, the Blood Demon Lord patted Chu Feng on the shoulder.
A pink mist poured into Chu Feng's body along the palm of her hand, and passed through his meridians so quickly that he had no time to mobilize his immortal power to resist.
At the same time, the Blood Charm Lord came close to Chu Feng's ear and exhaled like a orchid.
"I'm waiting for you in the secret realm..."
The Blood Demon Lord retracted his hand and turned to face the dark land filled with ghosts.
The suffocating pressure of the Immortal Emperor suddenly burst out from her body, and blood-red light rose from her body into the sky, dyeing half of the sky in the Netherworld a shocking red.
The Yin Qi was evaporated the moment it came into contact with the blood and light around her. Those ghosts let out shrill screams, but before they could even escape, they were burned into nothingness by the phantom law contained in the blood and light.
"Phantom Blood Escape!"
Her red lips opened slightly, and her figure suddenly turned into a pink stream of light, cutting directly into the depths of the Netherworld like a sharp blade that penetrated the heaven and earth.
The void where the stream of light passed shook violently, and countless dark space cracks spread crazily from both sides of the trajectory in all directions.
Any ghost standing in front of the flowing light will be knocked to pieces the moment it comes into contact with the flowing light.
That pink stream of light spanned the entire land of darkness, like a pink Milky Way across the sky.
The pink mist circulates to form a long corridor, isolating all the surrounding Yin Qi.
